remarks: Welcome to 11 Woodlawn Ave, a beautifully renovated home located in the heart of Norwalk. This stunning property has been completely updated to offer modern living at its finest. The home features a brand new roof, siding, windows, electrical system, and freshly painted walls, ensuring a move-in ready experience. Step inside to discover two newly renovated kitchens, complete with modern finishes and top-of-the-line appliances, perfect for entertaining or everyday cooking. The home also boasts 3.5 beautifully updated bathrooms, offering both style and comfort. New flooring throughout the home adds a touch of elegance to every room. Located in the desirable Flax Hill neighborhood, this home is just minutes away from local amenities such as shopping centers, restaurants, parks, and schools. For commuters, you'll have easy access to I-95, Route 7, and the Norwalk train station, making travel a breeze. With its combination of modern updates, prime location, and convenient access to everything Norwalk has to offer, 11 Woodlawn Ave is the perfect place to call home. Don't miss the opportunity to make it yours!
